structure.layout: single-column marketing landing page: sticky top nav with dropdown menus, split hero (copy + app screenshot), press-quote strip, stacked alternating feature sections with scroll-driven media, video showcase grid, tabbed template card row, AI video feature, stats marquee, centered closing CTA, 5-column fat footer

aesthetics.typography: Graphik for headings (bold grotesk, h1 55px) and base body; Inter for nav, buttons, body copy, card text and footer; Caecilia (slab serif, italic) for the press quotes; Shantell Sans handwritten for the Take a peek annotation
aesthetics.typeScale: Strong contrast: 55px bold H1, 44px closing H2, 38px section headings, 21-22px muted body/subcopy, 16px UI/nav/card text, 12px legal links; colored 16-17px bold eyebrows above section headings

notes: Warm off-white page with section-tinted backgrounds (peach, mint, pale green) and soft peach gradient panels behind product screenshots. Signature red #e44232 CTA buttons have a glossy diagonal highlight and a pink drop ledge under them (3D pressable look). Feature sections each use a different colored eyebrow (red, teal, red, green) matching the media; right-hand media is sticky/scroll-driven so it appears empty in the full-page capture for sections 2-4. Press quotes set in italic slab serif contrast with the sans UI. Handwritten annotation with a hand-drawn arrow points to the video bento grid. Stats rendered as whimsical illustrated scenes (pebble cairn with flag, terrain map) in a marquee. Template category pills are implemented as a radiogroup. Cookie consent floats bottom-right as a card overlay.
